purpose: External rest-of-season research for waiver and trade decisions. This is a relative market layer, not a replacement for the league-scored weekly forecast.

league_context.translation_warning: Most public ROS rankings below are PPR consensus or trade-value proxies. Use them to compare players and tiers; do not treat them as exact points in this league.

Agreement or disagreement across independent sources
Role, health, schedule and playoff outlook

rules: Read this file before giving waiver or trade advice.
ESPN projection is the league-specific weekly baseline only; it is not a ROS ranking.
Join this research to the current ESPN snapshot by player id because ownership, availability and injury status change.
Surface source disagreement and stale or paywalled evidence instead of silently presenting one source as truth.
A public PPR rank is relative evidence, not a direct forecast under this league's first-down scoring.

For all lineup, waiver, drop, trade and follow-up advice, consult current-week and ROS evidence from at least two non-ESPN source families before firm recommendations; ESPN forecasts alone are insufficient.
LeagueLogs and FantasyPros ECR count as the same source family. Disclose shared experts and distinguish independent analysis from republished consensus.
Check each source season, scoring, week and update date; recheck stale imports and current role/injury news online. A new file timestamp does not refresh older source values.
Full roster reviews must cover every owned player including IR, K and DST, plus currently available alternatives joined by player id.
Distinguish weekly projections, ROS projected totals, positional ranks and trade values; label missing data and material source disagreements.
Before dropping an injury replacement with recent starter volume, verify the injured starter return status; an ESPN or older ROS backup valuation is not sufficient.
If external coverage is missing or gated, state the limitation and make the advice provisional rather than using ESPN as the sole judgment source.

current_decision_notes.question: A.J. Brown plus Jaylen Warren for Malik Nabers
current_decision_notes.answer: Decline or counter with A.J. Brown straight up. The independent trade-value proxy is Nabers 36.6 versus Brown 29.5 plus Warren 25.5, and Warren is more valuable to this roster than the raw ROS rank suggests because RB depth is thinner than WR depth.

current_decision_notes.question: Best currently available dropped WRs
current_decision_notes.answer: Romeo Doubs is the preferred first claim among the newly available names, followed by KC Concepcion for upside, then Jakobi Meyers for floor. Rashid Shaheed is a lower-priority volatility stash.

market.how_to_use: Cross-position (flex) order comes from fantasycalc.flex_rank and fantasypros trade_value; leaguelogs/espn are positional only. Join to the ESPN snapshot by player_id. fantasycalc refreshes via agent-tools/research-market; the other three are manual imports dated by fetched_on.

reviews.coverage: All 15 rostered players plus 17 available alternatives. Available pool screened against both external ROS tables. Factual ESPN ownership joins use player_id; external source names normalized and verified against position/team.

sources.format: Default PPR, 4-point passing TD, -1 passing INT, no first-down points
sources.notes: Default scoring verified from selected page controls. ROS total is remaining-season total, not points per game. No exact league conversion is claimed.

sources.notes: One source family with FantasyPros, not independent validation from two publishers. For RB/WR/TE, ROS position_rank is derived by counting that position in the complete overall board; average is mean overall expert rank. Weekly rank is table placement, not rounded mean rank. Some experts may overlap Footballguys.

reviews.question: Trade: Skattebo + Corum + Kraft to Josh for Jaylen Warren + Colston Loveland

sources.format: Half PPR ROS, projected points weeks 11-17 incl. byes

sources.publisher: RotoWire / NBC Sports / Fantasy Life / CBS

players.name: Jaylen Warren
players.note: Dowdle healthy; Wk10 snaps ~38% vs Dowdle ~48%. Easiest FP playoff SOS.

players.name: Blake Corum
players.note: Wk11 bye. Now 1a over Kyren Williams in neutral situations; 6 straight games 12.8+ league pts.

players.name: Cam Skattebo
players.note: Hamstring cleared before Wk10 (28.2 league pts).

players.name: Tucker Kraft
players.note: Wk11 bye; one catch in each of Wk9-10.

reviews.answer: Decline as offered. Per-game FP ROS puts starting RB/FLEX/TE about 5 points LOWER over weeks 11-17 after the trade (Warren replaces Corum as RB3; Loveland ~= Kraft), and RSJ values the outgoing side 4347 vs 3726. A 2-for-2 keeping Corum is a wash (+1). Fix the Wk11 TE bye with a streamer (Okonkwo available).
